notes.title: Spring Time!
notes.content:
Dear Candy Reclaimers!

Spring is upon us! Thus, Halloween Candy Reclaim got a decidedly "easterly" touch- enjoy battling easter bunnies and easter eggs and enjoy the fresh leaves the wind whirls around you. For a short time only!

We hope you enjoy the game over Easter with your family - and if you haven't already, it would be great if you could also spread the word and leave a review!

All the best,

Philip & Kids

notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content:
Dear Candy Reclaimers,

the holidays are upon us! As a special treat, experience Halloween Candy Reclaim in Christmas mode - with snow, presents, snowmen, and snowballs! Only during the holidays, so make sure you play! :-)

If you haven't already, help us spread the word! Leave a review on the store and tell your friends! ;-)

Philip & the kids!
